You type Chinese:

EVZheng-Lab/ad-asset-bible.body:
# ad-asset-bible (Assistant Director: Asset Inventory)

Claude Code Skill: turns a script into an **asset inventory**. It answers how many locations the script has, how many people and outfits, and how many cross-scene props, how many variants each needs, and which variant each scene uses. The output is the upstream input for [Lira](https://github.com/higgsfield-ai) (Higgsfield's official image-prompt skill).

## Changelog

- **2026-11-13**: Added **effects** (`effects[]`, the fifth tab). It only collects effects that recur and need visual consistency (a portal, a particular character's shockwave, a whirlwind from a certain skill). It locks the look only and does not write motion rhythm. `from` records who emits the effect. Boundaries: a prop that glows after being activated counts as a state variant of the prop; monsters and creatures count as characters; effects that appear only once are left to the video prompt. See `references/how-to-write-vfx.md` for details. Same-day addition: the effect description is split into **static** (`brief`, for the image model to draw the effect itself, without writing where it is emitted from or how it changes) and **dynamic** (`motion`, required, for the video model to perform the motion rules). Each is copied separately on the page.
- **2026-09-12**: On the page (tab descriptions / archive legend) and in the copied archive and voice text, removed all "usage instructions meant for people". Those words were read by downstream models along with the payload and interfered with their understanding of the content itself, so the delivery rule now only places them in the step-9 report. Added the criterion "a different scene number does not mean a different scene or event" (vertical short dramas have one scene per episode, and the same scene is often split into several scene numbers). In `build.mjs`, added an exemption table for downstream-word false positives ("彩色相纸" was blocked because it contains "色相").
- **2026-09-09**: Added a **fourth block, "Character Bios"** (`bios[]`). Every character with a base file gets a performance bio describing **how this person acts and what their voice sounds like**: body language, psychological engine, speech style, habitual gestures, gait, the conditions under which their mask cracks, the one thing that makes them soften, how their eyes come alive, the four elements of Voice, and the goal that runs through the whole film. It also adds `arc[]` ("what changed later") to record stage changes for characters with an arc. See "Fourth block: character bios" below.
- **2026-08-30**: Base files now treat "the first costume is the initial state" (no separate placeholder costume image). The world-view summary now includes geographic location and the ethnicity conclusion.
- **2026-08-29**: First release. Added the end-to-end usage of "Agent chains this skill → Lira", the rule that a human must state the aspect ratio, and the note that when the "Lira Prompt" column is reworked, the whole chain must be rerun, not only `build.mjs`.

## Discover every shot worth keeping

Locution Pro brings **media management, frame search, shot organization, and clip export** together in one workspace. From massive footage to selected shots, it makes finding easier and organizing more orderly.

Landscape establishing shots, event footage, and long interview recordings can all be started right away. **Browse, search, and organize footage without subtitles.** When subtitles are available, you can also find clips by dialogue text or meaning.

# TG Persona · Telegram Persona Clone

An automatic reply tool for personal accounts, deployed on a small VPS. **It is not a bot.** It logs into your own Telegram account and, when someone in a monitored group posts a keyword you have set, replies with text or reacts with an emoji as you. Everything is managed through a **web visual dashboard** (http://IP:port).

## Features

- **Visual TG login**: configure the shared API_ID / API_HASH once in the dashboard. When adding a second or third account, enter a note, then directly input the phone number, verification code, and two-step verification password. Each account's session is stored independently, so there is no need to log in again after a restart.
- **Dashboard security**: passwords are stored as scrypt hashes. Random session tokens are strictly validated server-side with a 30-day validity period. After 3 consecutive failed logins, a PNG bitmap captcha is required (single-use, valid for 3 minutes), and 10 failures lock the account for 10 minutes. Forged proxy headers are not trusted by default, changing the password requires verifying the original password, and Secure Cookies are automatically enabled under HTTPS.
- **Group management**: list all groups the account has joined (searchable), with one-click join / stop monitoring.
- **Keyword rules**:
  - Multiple keywords separated by commas (any match triggers), regex supported
  - Three actions to choose from: reply with text / react with emoji / reply + emoji
  - Multiple reply texts are separated by `||`, and one is picked at random to look more human
  - **Active groups**: each rule can be individually limited to specific groups (unchecked = all monitored groups)
- **Automation tasks** (Automation page):
  - **Check-in**: runs daily at a random moment within a set time window. Commands support `|` for random choice among multiple options, and random placeholders `{num:N}`, `{word:N}`, `{alpha:N}`, `{uuid}`. It can automatically click reply buttons, judge success or failure by keywords, extract points with regex, retry on send failure (0-5 times), and send to groups.
    - **Find button by emoji**: some bots change their button text every time (e.g., 'Good luck is coming' / 'Destiny decided') while the icon stays the same. Entering an emoji (e.g., 🧧) reliably matches the button.
    - **Rapid clicks**: some bots need several rapid clicks to take effect. You can set a click count of 1-20 plus an interval of 50-3000ms, and the latest buttons are re-fetched before each click.
  - **Snipe monitoring**: watches groups for invite codes / registration-open messages and auto-replies, or sends registration text in the group (`{code}` placeholder). # OCRMiniTool (OCR Mini Tool)

A local graphical OCR tool. **Your data never leaves your computer.** Built on Baidu's open-source [**Unlimited-OCR-2**](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2) (MIT, about 3.3B parameters), it parses dragged-in images or PDFs into Markdown text. It has a **WebView interface** (native WebView2 window) and supports CUDA GPU acceleration as well as pure CPU inference (detected automatically).

> The UI framework is based on [Superce1l/STTMiniTool](https://github.com/Superce1l/STTMiniTool) (the same local HTTP server + SSE + WebView2 architecture and visual language). Upstream model: [baidu/Unlimited-OCR](https://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR)

---

## Key Features

- 🖼️ **Images / PDF → Markdown**: jpg, png, bmp, webp, and tiff are recognized on drop; PDFs are automatically converted to images page by page (pymupdf)
- 📚 **Two recognition modes**: **Merged parsing** (multiple files treated as pages of the same document, with cross-page context in a single request) and **batch recognition** (each file recognized independently with its own result; failures don't interrupt the queue, and it can be cancelled at any time)

ZPL-03/MechAgent.body:
# MechAgent

MechAgent is an open-source CAE/FEA multi-agent orchestration framework. It provides a local Studio, a CLI, and a Python SDK, and organizes natural-language engineering requests into parametric modeling, meshing, solving, post-processing, verification, and reporting.

The framework connects engineering tasks with external tools through capability registration, tool registration, and Pydantic data contracts. Solvers and meshers are replaceable backends, and dedicated solver formats and compilation logic are managed by adapters. The built-in execution capability is linear-elastic static analysis of structures, using CalculiX and Gmsh. For the specific input scope, see [Capabilities and Natural Language Parsing](https://github.com/ZPL-03/MechAgent/blob/HEAD/docs/capabilities.md).

## Studio

Studio uses an engineering workbench layout: inputs and the load-case library on the left, geometry, mesh, and result viewports in the center, acceptance and execution evidence on the right, and the engineering report below. The interface supports Chinese and English, as well as dark, light, and system-following themes. Switching language preserves the source language of engineering requests, reports, and tool diagnostics.

## Installation and Startup

Requires Python 3.10 or later. In the following, `python` refers to the activated, dedicated virtual environment. This machine's maintenance environment uses `D:/anaconda3/envs/AGENT/python.exe`.

```powershell
py -3.10 -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install -e packages/mechagent-core
python -m pip install -e "packages/mechagent[dev,docs]"
```

Copy `.env.example` to a local `.env` and set `CALCULIX_CCX` as needed. The LLM is configured through `URL`, `API_KEY`, and `MODEL_NAME`, and by default it does not take part in execution. When deterministic parsing is available, no LLM credentials are needed.

```powershell
python -m mechagent.cli doctor
python -m mechagent.cli studio --open-browser
python -m mechagent.cli demo
python -m mechagent.cli examples

luojiaaoo/xpeech.body:
Xpeech is a FastAPI-based Agent service. It provides a `/chat` endpoint that can receive text, images, and files, call a large language model to generate streaming replies, and call tools to complete tasks when needed.

Suitable for quickly launching an extensible AI Agent API service.

## Features

- Provides HTTP API and SSE streaming responses
- Supports text, image, and file input
- Supports multi-turn sessions and independent workspaces
- Supports LiteLLM-compatible large model services
- Supports built-in tools and custom Python tools
- Supports extending Agent tools through MCP Server
- Supports Feishu message bridging
- Supports one-time and periodic background scheduled Agent tasks on Feishu
- Uses `conf.toml` to centrally manage application configuration and secrets
- Stores session history in YAML format for better readability
- Automatic history message compression (three-level compression strategy) to avoid exceeding context limits
- Built-in memory system that automatically summarizes and saves key information
- Supports video input
- Token context usage rate and per-turn input, output, and total consumption statistics, supports `k` / `m` units; usage not returned is accumulated as `0`
- Rich built-in toolset: file read/write, Shell execution, web search and page fetching, HTML preview, Office document reading, file sending, asking the user questions

## Installation

Requires Python 3.12+ and uv. Project dependencies are installed with `uv sync`:

```bash
uv sync
```

The Shell tool and stdio MCP only support Linux and depend on the bubblewrap sandbox. On Debian/Ubuntu, install them with:

```bash
sudo apt-get install bubblewrap slirp4netns
```

Shell sandboxes are reused per user workspace: they are created on the first call, and different sessions of the same user share the sandbox's `/tmp`, network, and background processes.
Multiple shell commands from the same user can run concurrently in the same sandbox; output, timeouts, and cancellation are handled independently per request.
Each command uses an independent bash and starts from the workspace directory. Requests that are running or waiting for the sandbox to start keep the sandbox alive. After the last request finishes, if the sandbox stays idle continuously for `tool.shell.sandbox_idle_timeout_seconds` (default 600 seconds, i.e. 10 minutes), the sandbox and its background processes are automatically destroyed.
Calling it again afterward creates a new sandbox; workspace disk files are still retained.
All shell sandboxes are also cleaned up when the service shuts down. A sandbox that exits abnormally, or a switch of the Feishu token authentication mode, causes it to be recreated.

You can adjust the idle reclaim time in `conf.toml`; restart the service for the change to take effect:

```toml
[tool.shell]
sandbox_idle_timeout_seconds = 600
```

# 学习通 Assistant (XXTSign)

Native Android app for logging into 学习通 with multiple accounts. Supports batch check-in, automatic video course progression, and automatic answering of chapter quizzes. **Pure protocol implementation, no root required**: it does not reuse data from the 学习通 app. Instead, it maintains the login session for each account within the app itself.

## How to use (five tabs)

Five pages at the bottom: **Accounts / Check-in / Course Videos / Quizzes / Logs**.

1. On the "Accounts" page, log in and select the account used for course videos (single selection).
2. The "Course Videos" page handles videos only: fetch courses → expand chapters (task points are checked automatically) → select chapters to process → start.
3. The "Quizzes" page handles chapter quizzes only: courses under the same account reuse the cache. Expand a course (chapter quizzes are checked automatically) → select the chapters to complete → start answering. In the top-right corner of the Quizzes page, you can switch between "Chapter Quizzes" and "Assignments".
4. Check-in is operated on the "Check-in" page, with background patrol running persistently. View logs on the "Logs" page.

Video progression and quizzes do not interfere with each other: video progression does not submit quizzes along the way, and quiz answering does not touch videos. Both run only after the user taps "Start"; there is no global switch.

### Assignments

After switching to "Assignments" in the top-right corner of the Quizzes page, all **unsubmitted** assignments for the current account are listed, including course, title, status, and remaining time. Opening an assignment lets you:

- View question stems and options one question at a time. Assignments are "one question per page"; use the bottom "Previous / Next" buttons to navigate;
- Tap options directly to answer. Tap "Save Draft" to save the current question as a server-side draft. Tap "Submit" to first save all answered questions as drafts one by one, then formally submit (with a second confirmation);
- AI suggestions are manual by default: tap "Ask AI" to query. If the "Auto AI suggestions" toggle is turned on, a query runs automatically when you move to a new question. Suggestions are for reference only and will not change options for you;
- View the source and the raw large-model output. You can tap "Ask AI" repeatedly to retry.

Loading the assignment list and turning pages only send GET requests. The server is written to only when you personally tap "Save Draft" or "Submit". Answers cannot be modified after submission.

The assignment endpoints are H5 pages (`mooc1-api.chaoxing.com/mooc-ans/work/...`). Server-side redesigns may break parsing; you can first try tapping "Refresh Assignment List" to retry.

## What it actually accomplishes (acceptance criteria)

**Give it a course, and the task points on the Course Videos page should all turn green, and all quizzes on the Quizzes page should be submitted.**

Specifically, three verifiable conditions:

1. All video task points are completed (Course Videos page);
2. All chapter quizzes are submitted and receive scores (Quizzes page);
3. No red incomplete task points remain in the course or chapter lists.

- **Course Videos page**: expanding a course automatically checks task points chapter by chapter. Completed chapters are marked blue directly, unfinished chapters show "Not checked", and after checking completes, chapters are marked green or gray based on video completion.
  Chapters that fail checking are marked red "Check failed" and are not cached. You can tap "Refresh" on the course card to retry; they are not disguised as "Not open".

tibidefengzi/ComfyUI-AD-Segmented-Loop.body:
# AD-分段循环 · ComfyUI-AD-Segmented-Loop

A material timeline and segmented-loop plugin for ComfyUI. It links material preparation, per-segment generation, preview comparison, and result saving into one workflow, suited to long-video segmented generation, latent bridge continuation, and shot-level redo.

## Four Core Nodes

1. **AD-素材准备**: Batch import and drag-and-drop for images, videos, and audio. Videos and audio each have a 3-track timeline supporting drag, trim, cut, splice, merge, multi-select move, and undo/redo. Smart splitting by bar, beat, shot, or breath point. Outputs reference images, reference video frames, reference video audio, reference audio, source video/audio, start frames, and mask-specific frames per segment.
2. **AD-分段生成**: Organizes segments by material duration or segment count. Strict 24 FPS frame locking, adapting to H3's 17k+5 generated frame count. Per-segment control of width, height, prompts, reference materials, and reference ranges. Built-in latent bridge continuation (with re-anchoring, seam exposure transition, and quality correction).
3. **AD-分段预览**: Per-segment playback, A/B comparison, re-rolling specified segments, stop-and-standby with breakpoint resume, continuous segment looping, clip merging, and history round viewing with loop playback. Connects to this segment's finished output to continue approving the next segment.
4. **AD-最终保存**: Batch “Process Selected / Continue Remaining” for externally processed results, with automatic archiving, clip merging, source/finished A/B comparison, high-quality preview, and master download. Supports master quality (near-lossless 4:4:4 CRF14, etc.).

A normal full-image run skips the **AD-最终保存** node. Results are only processed when you select them in the preview node and then click “Process Selected” in the final save node.

## Typical Wiring

```
AD-素材准备 ──reference materials / segment list──▶ AD-分段生成 (external: H3 conditioning / sampling / decoding)
        │                                    │
        └──preview media / context──▶ AD-分段预览 ◀──┘
                                   │
                                   └──results──▶ AD-最终保存
```

- The segment node's `context` connects to the preview node, and the preview node's `media` connects to this segment's `CreateVideo` output.
- The reference image, reference video, reference video audio, and reference audio ports of AD-素材准备 connect to the matching H3 reference inputs. The mask-specific port can connect to SAM/VAEEncode for local inpainting.
- H3's model, conditioning encoding, sampler, and decoding are connected in the external workflow. The installation package does not include models.

## Main Features

- **Multi-material import**: Images, videos, and audio are managed together, with batch loading and drag-and-drop import. H3's single reference output remains 10 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio clips.
- **CapCut-style timeline**: 3 tracks each for video and audio. Multi-select move, same-type track switching, independent head and tail trimming, cut, merge, and undo/redo. Edge dragging and trimming do not trigger transcoding. The playhead positions at 24 FPS.

# Claude Desktop Self-Healing Chinese Localization Toolkit (Claude Chinese Toolkit)

A recoverable Chinese localization toolkit for the Anthropic **Claude Desktop** desktop client (code version **v1.2.98**, adapted to **5.11492.2** in this round). It performs incremental maintenance on the official i18n resources and preserves existing translations and terminology rules.

---

## 🌟 Core Features

- **Native i18n reuse**: Incrementally generates Chinese resources and keeps the official English as a fallback.
- **Terminology rules preserved**: Distinguishes Diff (差异) from Change (变更), and Branch (分支) from Fork (分叉). Config keys, model IDs, protocol names, etc. are kept in English according to context.
- **Four-layer glossary**: Shell 1,664 entries (current English baseline 1,310 entries), Web UI 32,246 entries, 52 dynamic glossary entries, and 362 long-form descriptions. The counts include historical compatibility entries and intentionally retained English, and do not represent the current UI localization rate.
- **Collapsed body text checks** cover 147 'Learn more' references and 145 distinct body texts. The original description modules of 5.11492.2 have been verified, 12 newly added or rewritten body texts have been supplemented, and snapshot regressions for 4.4212, 4.16336, 4.23118, and 5.1231 have been retained. `npm run audit` checks the complete body text, code, links, and installer package source fingerprint.
- **New-version language registration**: Matches the main process by language-mapping structure and does not depend on obfuscated variable names that change with each build. Failures are reported when no match is found.
- **Recoverable installation**: Prepares and validates the dual ASAR files and the main program in a temporary directory, then prepares complete files in the target directory and replaces them. A recovery record is saved before any formal modification. After rollback, the full hash is verified, and an original backup for the same version is kept.
- **Update recognition**: Checks file SHA-256, toolkit version, and glossary digest. Newly updated official files take priority. Mixed versions or unidentified modifications are rejected, preventing old backups from rolling back new versions.
- **Practical checks**: Uses an ICU parser to check syntax, nested variables, format types, and select branches, and allows plural forms that comply with Chinese rules. Modified frontend and main-process JS files all undergo syntax checks.
- **Runtime boundaries**: Does not automatically create mirror clients and does not change Cowork installation eligibility, CC Switch routing, or the official update mechanism. A running client must save work and exit first.

---

## 🗺️ Project Scope and Structure

This project focuses on client UI localization. The four resource layers are the Shell native menus, the Ion/Web UI, dynamic model descriptions, and collapsed long-form documents. Third-party inference configuration pages are within the localization scope, while model routing, credential management, and account features remain the responsibility of the client and existing tools such as CC Switch.

The target for this round is the Windows **5.11492.2** installed via the official installer (system package version **5.11492.2.0**). macOS/Linux support the existing loose resource layout. Dual ASAR and executable integrity synchronization is implemented and verified on the Windows path.
